set -e
URL='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emilnabil/download-plugins/main/advancedscreenshot/enigma2-plugin-extensions-advancedscreenshot_all.ipk'
PKG='/tmp/enigma2-plugin-extensions-advancedscreenshot_all.ipk'
if command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then wget -O "$PKG" "$URL"; elif command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fL "$URL" -o "$PKG"; else echo 'wget or curl is not available'; exit 1; fi
[ -s "$PKG" ] || { echo 'IPK download failed'; exit 1; }
command -v opkg >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'opkg package manager is not available in this image'; exit 1; }
opkg install "$PKG"
rm -f "$PKG"
echo 'Installation finished; check the device log if dependency errors appear.'
